drawing.observation: The unique L-shaped trace and the adjacent drilled column register directly to the component-side owner photographs. The long column is an auxiliary drilled/copper field beside D11, not a drawn 14-pad package column. Position 159 points to the right-hand junction of a four-landing subfield: an upper landing reaches it by a long vertical trace, a left landing is drawn joined to it horizontally, and a lower annulus has its own downward trace. The corrected owner lower_exit near (2209,2305)/(813,2456) matches that separate annulus-and-downward-stem topology; its distance below the junction is much larger in the photo than in the undimensioned drawing, so drawing pixel spacing is not used as a placement constraint.

bridge_pair_solder_review.observation: Two distinct open annuli lie close to the package-local projected junction and left points, with approximately the same pair spacing and orientation as the front-side landings. bridge_pair_solder_review.limit: The two annuli are a leading cross-face pair, not certified same holes: the D11 fits are package-local and the auxiliary field lies outside the package. Meter front-to-back hole identities and left-to-junction continuity before assigning the drawn bridge.
